tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Screen ground behind every tab and sheet. Text on it: foreground, subtle, muted, accent and every status colour; the interviewer page ground and the settings drawer.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and grouped settings lists, a step lighter than background in Light; the preview panel before the camera starts, which keeps its Dark value in both themes; the empty stage, fields and the script editor on the interviewer page.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and the neutral status pill: a step lighter than surface in Dark, a step darker than background in Light; buttons and chips on the interviewer page.

tokens.name: surface-bar
tokens.usage: The bottom tab bar; the interviewer top bar and side panel.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Chips over the live camera image: REC 30 fps, the mic meter. The same in both themes, since the camera preview stays dark; chips over the phone video on the interviewer page.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims what is behind the recovery dialog: 72% near-black in Dark, 45% in Light. The pause overlay on the preview keeps the Dark value; the paused overlay on the interviewer page.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Behind a presented sheet (the Room sheet), where iOS shows the screen pushed back: black in both themes, as iOS draws it.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between sections, card and list outlines, the progress track. Decorative, never the only cue.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of secondary and ghost buttons, dialog edge, the sheet grabber. Dark: 1.9:1 on background, below the 3:1 control floor, so the fill and label mark the control. Light: 3.1:1 or more on background, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: segment-selected
tokens.usage: The selected segment of a segmented control (Camera, Appearance) under a foreground label: border-strong in Dark, an off-white step above the track in Light, as the native control draws it (16.8:1 for the label).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Titles and values on background, surface, surface-raised and surface-bar (13:1 or more in Dark, 12.9:1 or more in Light).

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Body copy in overlays and dialogs, info lines of the event log, segment rows; on background and the surfaces.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, units, captions, health row labels, inactive tabs; on every surface (6.2:1 or more in Dark, 7.4:1 or more in Light).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Disabled icons and the upload id line only: 4.1:1 on background and 3.7:1 on surface in Dark, 3.6:1 and 4.0:1 in Light.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, icon buttons, the active tab, the call row icon, the focus ring; on background, the surfaces and accent-soft (8.7:1 or more in Dark, 4.7:1 or more in Light).

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed links and text buttons.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind accent: the uploading chip, the good-quality chip, the first participant avatar (8.8:1 in Dark, 4.9:1 in Light).

tokens.name: participant
tokens.usage: Text of the second participant avatar; the first uses accent.

tokens.name: participant-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the second participant avatar.

tokens.name: record
tokens.usage: Fill of Start recording; outline of destructive buttons and the error notice (3.95:1 on background in Dark, 4.4:1 in Light).

tokens.name: on-record
tokens.usage: Label on the record fill (4.9:1 in Dark, 5.6:1 in Light).

tokens.name: recording
tokens.usage: Text and icons of the RECORDING pill and the REC strip; on recording-soft (7.3:1 in Dark, 5.3:1 in Light) and background.

tokens.name: recording-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the RECORDING pill, the REC strip and the error notice.

tokens.name: on-recording-soft
tokens.usage: Message text inside the error notice, on recording-soft (12.5:1 in Dark, 8.8:1 in Light).

tokens.name: recording-dot
tokens.usage: The live dot in the pill, the REC strip and the Record tab icon.

tokens.name: recording-detail
tokens.usage: Second, quieter text in the REC strip (segment number), on recording-soft (8.4:1 in Dark, 5.8:1 in Light).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error tone: health rows and log lines at error, FAIL, destructive button labels.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the error notice and the red health line.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Outline of the error notice and of destructive buttons.

tokens.name: paused
tokens.usage: Text and icons of the PAUSED pill and pause reasons; on paused-soft (8.8:1 in Dark, 5.3:1 in Light), warning-soft and background.

tokens.name: paused-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the PAUSED pill, the recovered chip and the warning count chip.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning tone: health rows and log lines at warning, warning icons, the title and link of the amber health line and of warning banners (10.7:1 on warning-soft in Dark, 5.5:1 in Light).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning banners (call dropped, disk space low, locked settings) and of the amber health line.

tokens.name: warning-line
tokens.usage: Outline of warning banners, top hairline of the amber health line, outline of the notice button. Decorative: the ground and the warning text carry the state.

tokens.name: on-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Message text of warning banners and the detail in the amber health line, on warning-soft (8.6:1 in Dark, 7.6:1 in Light).

tokens.name: resume
tokens.usage: Fill of Resume and of the warning badge on the Debug tab. Light takes a deeper amber, so the fill holds 3.9:1 on background and carries a white label.

tokens.name: on-resume
tokens.usage: Label on resume fills and badges: near-black in Dark (10.4:1), white in Light (5.0:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Lit meter bars, PASS, verified uploads, call quality excellent; on success-soft (7.9:1 in Dark, 5.2:1 in Light) and background.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the finished chip and the call quality chip.

tokens.name: meter-off
tokens.usage: Unlit meter bars; a lit success bar holds 3.9:1 or more against one.

tokens.name: progress
tokens.usage: Upload progress fill on a border track (5.1:1 in Dark, 3.4:1 in Light).

tokens.name: upload
tokens.usage: Fill of the Upload button.

tokens.name: on-upload
tokens.usage: Label on the upload fill (4.7:1 in Dark, 5.9:1 in Light).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button: Stop, Play.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on the primary fill (16:1 in Dark, 14:1 in Light).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Tab and sheet titles: Recordings, Debug, Settings, Room.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Dialog titles.

styles.name: overlay-title
styles.usage: The one line on a paused preview or an empty state.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Recording card time.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: Call row and participant names, Connected.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Settings rows.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Dialog body, paused preview text, empty-state text, banners.
styles.sample: iOS took the microphone for the call. Segment 2 is closed and safe on disk.

styles.name: alert-title
styles.usage: Title line of the error notice.

styles.name: link
styles.usage: Text buttons and the link inside a banner.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Health line, header meta, notices, screen captions.
styles.sample: File, camera and audio all normal

styles.name: footnote-strong
styles.usage: REC strip, warning title in the health line, event log header.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Second lines in rows, notes under cards and lists.

styles.name: chip-label
styles.usage: State, quality and track chips.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels in Settings and the Room sheet.

styles.name: pill-label
styles.usage: The uppercase phase pill.

styles.name: stat-label
styles.usage: Labels of the recovery stat tiles.

styles.name: count-label
styles.usage: The warning count chip in the event log header.

styles.name: badge-label
styles.usage: Counts in tab badges.

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: Inactive tab labels.

styles.name: tab-label-active
styles.usage: The active tab label.

styles.name: verdict
styles.usage: PASS or FAIL at the top of the verification sheet.

styles.name: button-large
styles.usage: Filled 60 pt buttons: Start recording, Resume, Stop.

styles.name: button-large-quiet
styles.usage: Raised 60 pt buttons: Pause.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Filled 48 pt buttons: Play in a dialog.

styles.name: button-quiet
styles.usage: Raised and ghost 48 pt buttons: Stop and keep 2 segments, Copy settings as JSON.

styles.name: button-compact
styles.usage: Filled 44 pt buttons: Upload.

styles.name: button-compact-quiet
styles.usage: Raised and ghost 44 pt buttons: Play, Verify, Cancel, Reconnect, Simulate crash.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: The session timer (tabular figures).

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Values in the recovery stat tiles.

styles.name: mono-body
styles.usage: The room name chip in the empty Room sheet.

styles.name: mono-meta
styles.usage: The room name under the Room title, the build line in Settings.

styles.name: mono-value
styles.usage: Health rows, segment lines, card meta, mono setting values.

styles.name: log
styles.usage: Event log lines and chips over the preview.

styles.name: mono-id
styles.usage: Upload id and object key.

styles.name: prompter
styles.usage: The question being asked on the interviewer page.
styles.sample: Tell me who you are and what your company does.

styles.name: stage-title
styles.usage: Title over the empty or paused stage of the interviewer page.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Title of the settings drawer on the interviewer page.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons on the interviewer page.

styles.name: control-large
styles.usage: The large buttons of the interviewer page.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Side panel tabs on the interviewer page.

spacing.note: Tailwind 4px steps; the token name is the class suffix (space-2.5 = gap-2.5).

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Meter bar gap, chip vertical padding, label-to-value gap in stat tiles.

tokens.name: space-0.75
tokens.usage: Event log line gap, tab icon-to-label gap, overlay chip vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Health row gap, header line gap, pill vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Inside the status pill, upload line gap, settings label-to-list gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons, between compact buttons, inside notices.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Between stacked controls, pill side padding, health panel vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Notice side padding, between recording cards, chip inset from the preview edge.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Card padding, controls vertical padding, header top padding, list row side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The screen gutter: side padding of every section; button side padding.

tokens.name: space-4.5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, between settings groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of the Settings scroll, empty-state side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding, gap between the satellites on the cover.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Side padding of the paused preview text.

radius.note: Every corner but a pill uses the continuous curve on iOS (borderCurve continuous).

tokens.name: radius-tick
tokens.usage: Ends of the pause bars and of thin level ticks.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Progress track and fill.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: The REC chip over the camera preview.

tokens.name: radius-segment
tokens.usage: The selected segment of a segmented control: the track radius minus its 2 px padding.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Track chips in the Room sheet, the mic chip over the preview, the room name chip and its Copy button.

tokens.name: radius-segmented
tokens.usage: Segmented control track: radius-sm minus its 1 px border.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons, notices and banners, stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Regular buttons, grouped settings lists, Room cards, the empty state.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons, recording cards, the top corners of sheets.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, chips, tab badges, avatars.
